nativePlatform.scope: Native Library and compatible app controls only
nativePlatform.portableSamples: HTML/CSS illustrations only; not native control specifications. Browser system colors approximate semantic surfaces; no sampled raster palette or synthesized tonal ramp is normative.

nativeBindings.selection: Native sidebar/inset List selection; neutral appearance and focus-dependent rendering
nativeBindings.accent: Color.accentColor; prominent PreviewActionStyle, not a Library-wide brand color
nativeBindings.conversationComposer: User-approved ChatGPT-inspired native refinement: 24pt radius; 12pt horizontal/9pt vertical inset; 32pt attachment/send/stop controls; one-to-six-line input; semantic controlBackgroundColor; one-point primary border at 0.1 opacity. No microphone or reasoning selector. Scope does not replace the rest of the conversation UI.

title.purpose: Document title: title2 semibold; list heading: title3 semibold. Sizes remain system-resolved.

row-title.purpose: SwiftUI body medium, up to two lines.

body.purpose: SwiftUI body; paragraphs add 4pt line spacing; code uses body.monospaced().

metadata.purpose: SwiftUI caption; coverage uses callout; counts use monospacedDigit().

nativeLayout.adaptation: Balanced NavigationSplitView and ViewThatFits action labels; no custom breakpoints.

components.name: Captured source action
components.description: Portable light/dark translation of PreviewActionStyle; native press colors and one-point border. Browser focus outline is illustrative, not a new SwiftUI rule.

components.name: Search this view
components.description: Plain native search field; browser system-color illustration omits SF Symbols rather than substituting glyph icons.

components.name: Library navigation
components.description: Illustration of semantic navigation and selected-label ink, not a replacement for native sidebar List rendering.

components.name: Saved document row
components.description: Title/kind/filing hierarchy only; native inset List supplies actual selection, separators, and multi-selection.

components.name: Markdown reading
components.description: Portable hierarchy illustration; title2/headline/body sizes are browser approximations, not fixed native tokens. Native text is selectable and contains no remote images or scripts.

narrative.overview:
Apple design language with ChatGPT-inspired restraint: familiar controls, compact navigation, and a generous reading pane. This records the finished Library and compatible app controls, not a redesign of conversation, settings, Graph, or Mind Map. Deferred graph surfaces keep their existing code and data.

The product's platform posture is adaptive; the shipping surface is SwiftUI on macOS 26+ only. No web, iOS, or Android implementation is implied. Native system typography and SF Symbols are intentional here, including titles. There are no shipping raster assets in this Library world.
keyCharacteristics: Semantic macOS surfaces and system light/dark appearance.
Native sidebar, searchable list, and selectable Markdown reading.
Quiet provenance and explicit handoff to #general.

rules.name: The Semantic Surface Rule
rules.body: Use native semantic surfaces for Library backgrounds; do not replace them with sampled screenshot colors.

dos: Do preserve native semantic colors, text styles, SF Symbols, and keyboard-accessible controls.
Do distinguish saved sources, generated summaries, and personal notes while keeping originals reachable.
Do keep Library browsing and reading independent of inference.
donts: Don't replace this Library with decorative cards, branded status bars, or a visualization dashboard.
Don't add a second composer or send a request automatically on handoff.
Don't extend these Library decisions into unseen Graph, Mind Map, or settings redesigns.
